name: sprite2d
description: Pictures for entities: a sprite is one cell of an atlas drawn at the entity's Position, and an animation steps through consecutive cells. Tiles, characters, items and effects are all sprites.

components.name: Sprite
components.description: Draws one cell of an atlas centred on the entity's Position. atlas names an atlas of the game (game.json "atlases"); frame is the cell number, counted row by row from the top left. width and height are in world units, 0 meaning the cell's own size. Sprites with a higher layer are drawn over lower ones; at equal layers the older entity is drawn first. red, green, blue and alpha (0 to 255) tint and fade the picture; 255 leaves it as it is.

components.name: SpriteAnimation
components.description: Makes the entity's Sprite play the cells first_frame, first_frame + 1, ... for frame_count cells, each shown for ticks_per_frame simulation ticks. With looping it starts over; without, it stays on the last cell. elapsed counts the ticks played and is the animation's own state: leave it at 0, or set it to start part-way.

systems.name: animate
systems.description: Advances every SpriteAnimation by one tick and sets its Sprite's frame. It runs in the simulation, so an animation is the same on every run and every machine.

systems.name: draw
systems.description: Asks the renderer to draw every Sprite, lowest layer first. Presentation only: it never changes the simulation. The frame is ended by whoever runs the loop.
